## Forum Energy Technologies to Participate in Water Tower Research Virtual Insights Conference


September 21, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.f-e-t.com/node/15576/pdf)


HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 21, 2026-- Forum Energy Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: FET) announced today that Neal Lux, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Lyle Williams, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the Water Tower Research Virtual Insights Conference on Tuesday, September 22, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. Central Time.


The fireside chat can be accessed at the following link:


[https://event.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1770861&tp_key=bfed48f4a8](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Furl.us.m.mimecastprotect.com%2Fs%2FFnEmCR67PwTB3yPVU9f66i1yVA_%3Fdomain%3Devent.webcasts.com&esheet=54608085&newsitemid=20260921259607&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.webcasts.com%2Fstarthere.jsp%3Fei%3D1770861%26amp%3Btp_key%3Dbfed48f4a8&index=1&md5=cb4c7ed4103f5570e7b5a9540e733d0b)


A link to the live webcast will be available on the morning of the event on FET’s Investor Relations web page at[ir.f-e-t.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.f-e-t.com%2F&esheet=54608085&newsitemid=20260921259607&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.f-e-t.com&index=2&md5=e517218571af06457dd59d469667f714) .


*FET® is a global manufacturing company, serving the oil, natural gas, defense, and renewable energy industries. With headquarters located in Houston, Texas, FET provides value-added solutions aimed at improving the safety, efficiency, and environmental impact of our customers' operations. For more information, please visit[www.f-e-t.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.f-e-t.com&esheet=54608085&newsitemid=20260921259607&lan=en-US&anchor=www.f-e-t.com&index=3&md5=603a2e01b5509cede59a29b77b683c9c) .*
